summary: Enhance your skills in groundwater management and protection with our comprehensive training programs. Join us to safeguard vital water resources today!
lede: Groundwater management uses aquifer monitoring and risk assessment to guide decisions about water quantity and quality. This training is for professionals in groundwater, water supply, environmental protection, and oversight who need to make practical decisions from available evidence. It develops skills in interpreting water-level and quality trends, screening aquifer vulnerability, and planning abstraction controls and protection measures.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work with groundwater, water supply, environmental protection, or regulatory oversight and need a more structured way to manage aquifer risk.
prerequisites: Bring a laptop for document review and mapping exercises, plus a willingness to work with borehole logs, monitoring tables, and sample groundwater datasets. Experience with Excel and basic GIS viewing is helpful, and prior exposure to hydrology, hydrogeology, or water supply operations will make the exercises easier to apply.
topics: Water & wastewater treatment and utility management
